from words import word_count

exec(compile(p.read_text(), \"words.py\", \"exec\"))
for value, expected in [(\"\", 0), (\" \\t\\n\", 0), (\"one\", 1), (\"one two\", 2), (\" one\\t two\\nthree  \", 3), (\"one\\u2003two\", 2)]:

print(\"GREEN: 6 word-count cases passed\", flush=True)
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover(\".\"))
assert result.wasSuccessful()
import importlib, words, summary
importlib.reload(words)
importlib.reload(summary)
actual = summary.summarize(\"one two\\nthree\")
print(\"Integration observation:\", actual, \"expected:\", {\"words\": 3, \"lines\": 2})
print(\"Final words.py:\\n\" + p.read_text())'"
